• “Project” means an individual engagement, campaign, research assignment, consultation, creative assignment, or other agreed scope of work.
• “Proposal” means a quotation, offer, statement of work, service description, package selection, media plan, or other document outlining the scope, deliverables, fees, and terms of a Project.

• “Deliverables” means materials created specifically for the Client under an agreed Project, such as strategies, research reports, campaign concepts, advertising materials, copy, presentations, designs, communication frameworks, or reports.
• “Client Materials” means information, data, logos, trademarks, copy, images, documents, product information, claims, customer information, or other materials supplied by the Client.

• “Media Spend” means amounts paid or payable to advertising platforms, publishers, broadcasters, media owners, social platforms, search platforms, outdoor advertising operators, or other media providers for advertising placement.

• “Third-Party Costs” means external expenses incurred in connection with a Project, such as media spend, research panels, survey respondents, stock assets, printing, photography, video production, translation, distribution, databases, software, publishers, influencers, or specialist suppliers.

• “Third-Party Services” means platforms, media channels, software, research providers, suppliers, publishers, advertising networks, payment providers, or other external services used in connection with our work.
